scenarios.prompt: Create a workflow named addition-workflow that accepts two numbers a and b, uses add-numbers, and returns the numeric result in a result field.

Create a workflow named customer-ticket-workflow that accepts customer email and support summary strings, looks up the customer with lookup-customer, then creates a support ticket with create-support-ticket using the looked-up customerId and the original summary. Return the created ticket result.

Create a workflow named parallel-customer-lookup-workflow that accepts two customer email strings, looks both customers up in parallel using lookup-customer, and returns both lookup results in a clear object.

Create a workflow named parallel-support-fanout-workflow that accepts a customer email, a customerId, and a support summary. In parallel, look the customer up with lookup-customer and open a ticket with create-support-ticket, then return both results in a clear object.
Create a workflow named support-answer-workflow that accepts a prompt string, calls support-agent, and returns the agent actual text in a response field.

runInput.prompt: How do I reset my password?

scenarios.prompt: Create a workflow named nested-greeting-workflow that accepts a name string, invokes greeting-workflow, and returns its message.

Create a workflow named foreach-customer-lookup-workflow that accepts an array of objects where each item has a required email string, uses a foreach step to run lookup-customer for every item, and returns an array of customer objects with customerId, email, and plan.
Create a workflow named topic-subtopics-blurbs that takes a topic, uses an agent to generate an array of 3 subtopics, then uses a foreach step to write a one-line blurb for each subtopic.

Create a workflow named priority-support-router that accepts prompt and priority strings. Use a conditional step so urgent priority routes to support-agent with an urgent-support prompt, while any non-urgent priority routes to support-agent with a normal-support prompt. Return the selected agent actual text in a response field.

Create a workflow named priority-support-router-normal-route that accepts prompt and priority strings. Use a conditional step so urgent priority routes to support-agent with an urgent-support prompt, while any non-urgent priority routes to support-agent with a normal-support prompt. Return the selected agent actual text in a response field.

Create a workflow named mixed-support-pipeline that accepts customer email and support summary strings, looks up the customer, asks support-agent to prepare an answer using the customer context, creates a support ticket with the looked-up customerId and original summary, and returns both the agent text and created ticket result.

Create a workflow named strict-support-answer-workflow with an input schema that requires exactly a prompt string and no additional properties, and an output schema that requires exactly a response string and no additional properties. Use support-agent to produce the response.

runInput.prompt: How do I reset my password?

scenarios.prompt: Create a workflow named strict-support-ticket-workflow with an input schema that requires exactly an email string and a summary string with no additional properties, and an output schema that requires exactly an agentText string and a ticket object containing ticketId and status strings with no additional properties. Use support-agent for the agentText and create-support-ticket for the ticket.
Create a workflow named topic-subtopics-blurbs-single-agent that takes a topic and generates 3 subtopics, then writes a one-line blurb for each.
